description: Ticketmaster Discovery API — search venues by keyword, city, stateCode, countryCode, or postalCode. Returns venue name, address, city, state, capacity, coordinates and the venue id to pass to event_search as venueId.

keyword.description: Venue name to search for, e.g. "Madison Square Garden".

page.description: 0-based page number. Deep paging is capped at page × size ≤ 1000.

sort.description: Sort order. Ticketmaster accepts only these values for venues; anything else is a 400.

name: venue_search

outputSchema.description: Raw JSON response from Ticketmaster venue search API

title: Venue Search
